requirements.description: Bug fix: ConnectInterceptor props mutation causing render error

evidence.issue: React 18 development mode freezes props objects. The connect-interceptor.js code was mutating props.onNext and props.grantPermit directly, causing 'Cannot add property onNext, object is not extensible' error caught by ForgeErrorBoundary.
evidence.fix: Replaced in-place props mutation with Object.assign({}, props, { onNext, grantPermit }) pattern. Tests continue to pass.
